## The shape of the New Realm, as a grid of terrain classes.
##
## Written by tools/trace-realm-map.js. Do not edit by hand.
##
## The client carries no map — the realm is generated on the server and
## streamed tile by tile — so unlike every other data file here this one
## is not read out of an installed client. It is traced from an annotated
## picture of the realm and reduced to one letter per cell: a topology for
## the atlas to draw its own way, not a copy of the picture.
##
## Which biome each colour is comes from realm-biomes.txt, which is a
## player's reading rather than anything either source states.
##
## 248 by 258, one character a cell. "." is off the island.
##   a  #434a52    5072 cells   Deep Sea Abyss
##   b  #5b6945    4336 cells   Carboniferous
##   c  #799831    4011 cells   Floral Escape
##   d  #231843    3450 cells   Haunted Hallows
##   e  #a0bde4    2968 cells   Runic Tundra
##   f  #31051e    2364 cells   Sanguine Forest
##   g  #d2c69f    2167 cells   Coral Reefs
##   ~  #375ca6    2419 cells   sea
##   h  #704e1c    1855 cells   Dead Church
##   i  #2c352f    1569 cells   Shipwreck Cove
##   j  #87675b    1497 cells   Abandoned City
##   k  #404a6d    1377 cells   Sprite Forest
##   l  #946e36    1303 cells   High Plains
##   m  #1f283d    1046 cells   unnamed
##   n  #888a1d     947 cells   unnamed
##   o  #300f10     828 cells   Risen Hell
##   p  #fdd5a2     790 cells   Desert
##   q  #3a421c     742 cells   Mid Forest
##   r  #373d5b     720 cells   Undead Forest
##   s  #235f24     628 cells   Mid Plains
##   t  #d1bc99     602 cells   Beach
##   u  #2d3a1b     476 cells   High Forest
##   ~  #467cc7    2419 cells   sea
##   v  #69a453     386 cells   Abandoned City
##   w  #aa9177     236 cells   Abandoned City
##   x  #45455b     246 cells   unnamed
##   =  #757c72     167 cells   road
##   y  #b79679     155 cells   unnamed
##   z  #795d63      71 cells   Abandoned City
##   A  #a88e7f      90 cells   unnamed
##   B  #424b6d     107 cells   Sprite Forest
##   C  #2f0f17      75 cells   unnamed
##   D  #60170f      34 cells   unnamed
